title: CBPR - BRCA Genetic Testing Among Orthodox Jews
brief_summary: This study evaluates a web-based decision aid, named RealRisks, in promoting genetic testing intention among Orthodox Jewish women. 50 Orthodox Jewish women will take a baseline survey, self-administer the decision aid, and then complete two more surveys: one within one month of completing the decision aid and one at 6 months after completing the decision aid.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \>= 25 years of age
* Completed a previous cross-sectional survey and agreed to future contact
* Eligible for BRCA testing based on Six Point Scale

Exclusion Criteria:

* Personal history of breast or ovarian cancer
* Prior genetic counseling or genetic testing for BRCA mutations
* Participated in previous RealRisks workshop
